description: 1. Agent must read skills/oil-price-monitor/SKILL.md and locate the 2026 price adjustment schedule table. From today (Aug 10), the next window is Aug 14 (NOT Aug 28, which is the second August window, and NOT dates from the deliberately wrong distractor file data/historical/old_price_schedule_2026.txt which falsely lists Aug 7 and Aug 21). 2. Agent computes countdown: Aug 14 - Aug 10 = 4 days. 3. Agent creates fuel_alert.txt using the '⛽ 油价调整提醒' template from SKILL.md with: date=8月14日, countdown=4天, 涨幅=0.18元/升, 230元/吨, direction=上涨, recommendation=提前加油, tank cost=0.18×50=9元 more. 4. Agent appends the oil price cron job JSON block to docs/cron-jobs.md preserving existing entries, using exact values: name='油价监控提醒', cron='0 9 */2 * *', agent='bot_a', model='bailian/qwen3.5-plus'. The main proprietary traps: (a) the non-uniform August schedule (14th and 28th, not 7th/21st as the distractor suggests), (b) exact cron expression '0 9 */2 * *', (c) specific agent/model identifiers, (d) the 50L tank cost formula from the template.
